title: 第二千六百六十六章 蛮荒古国的真实底蕴第二千六百六十五章 罗格●乌特金的行动
content_zh:
可能是因为远古蛮荒时期的传承保存得较为完整之故，相较于其它地区，蛮荒古国的原住民npc对玩家们的恶意没有这么大。
在他们看来，玩家和原住民npc并无区别，只是各有各的立场而已。
蛮荒古国本来就有大量的教派、氏族和部落，各方势力都有自己的立场和诉求，蛮荒古国的原住民npc早已见怪不怪。
只要玩家们愿意遵守蛮荒古国的规矩，不去触碰各方势力共同划定的底线，立场什么的根本无所谓。
但前提是，玩家们得有相应的实力才行。
正因如此，蛮荒古国的向心力并不差，在某些方面甚至比大汉帝国的玩家还要强，只是因为各个教派、氏族和部落的对立，存在明显的内耗问题，没有办法将所有力量拧成一股，所以在王者御魂争霸赛中才会屡吃败仗，迟迟没能拿下最后的冠军。
不过，这对蛮荒古国来说，也未尝不是一件好事。
由于蛮荒古国各方势力共同划定了一条底线，各方势力的斗争虽使蛮荒古国一直存在明显的内耗，却始终维持着斗而不破的局面。
不管是玩家还是原住民npc，在这样的环境下都只能拼命内卷。
蛮荒古国的大环境有点类似于养蛊，但又没有养蛊这么惨烈，虽然顶级人才培养起来依旧不轻松，却从来不缺所谓的中流砥柱，从未遭遇青黄不接的窘境。
罗格●乌特金其实一直没有搞清楚，他之所以能参与蛮荒古国对海王类生物的开年狩猎季，并不在于他整出来的，带有蛮荒古国风格的船舰，而在于他本身有了拥有c级层次的战力。
注意！是c级战力，不是c级伪战力。
在二转b级层次等级未满的情况下，提前拥有c级层次的战力，才是最关键的要素。
正因上述的种种原因，这名原住民npc在发现罗格●乌特金的举动以后，只是饶有兴致地观察着，并没有进一步的动作。
〝咦！这个空间波动……洞天福地？〞
就在罗格●乌特金与一众佣兵团成员，同时打开四阁（农、林、渔、牧）组织成员所拥有的半位面领地，取出各类资源进行建设之际，一道隐晦的波动也随之扩散，引来这名原住民npc的注意。
〝嗯……不对！这不是完整的洞天福地开启所散发出来的波动，而是大量的福地雏形同时开启所引发的共振波动。〞
这名原住民npc先是眉头一皱，随即便想到了些什么，眼眸微微一亮：〝看来，应是近期盛传的四阁组织。呵呵，有趣，真是有趣。〞
这名原住民npc摸了摸自己的络腮胡，喃喃自语道：〝我说呢！这些小家伙不好好地狩猎海王类生物，跑到这狗不拉屎鸟不生蛋的地方做什么，原来是打算到海外之地这边发展啊！〞
〝也是。有四阁组织赋予的福地雏形支持，在这边发展确实不错，除了没有矿以外，几乎要啥有啥。〞

〝有木料能自己造船，粮食也不缺，还能肆意猎捕海王类生物……啧啧啧！这样一想，还真是不错。〞
〝虽然说，在新年庆典过后，海王类生物会重新沉寂下来，没有这么好找，但猎捕难度也会随之下降，长久时间下来，能猎捕到的海王类生物只会更多。〞
〝只可惜，这种方法不能推广，只能偷偷地来。如若不然，海外之地的那些虫豸，只怕又要闹腾了。〞
content_en:
Perhaps because the inheritance from the ancient wilderness period is relatively intact, compared to other areas, the aboriginal NPCs in the ancient wilderness country are not so malicious towards the players.
In their view, there is no difference between players and aboriginal NPCs, they just have their own positions.
There are a large number of sects, clans and tribes in the ancient wilderness country, and all forces have their own positions and demands. The aboriginal NPCs in the ancient wilderness country have long been accustomed to it.
As long as the players are willing to abide by the rules of the ancient wild country and not touch the bottom line jointly drawn by all forces, it doesn't matter what their position is.
But the premise is that the players must have corresponding strength.
Because of this, the centripetal force of the Wild Ancient Kingdom is not bad, and in some aspects it is even stronger than the players of the Han Empire. However, due to the opposition between various sects, clans and tribes, there are obvious internal friction problems, and there is no way to twist all the forces into one force. Therefore, they have repeatedly suffered defeats in the King of Soul Contest, and have been unable to win the final championship.
However, this may not be a bad thing for the ancient wild country.
Since all the forces in the ancient Wild Country have jointly drawn a bottom line, although the struggle between the various forces has caused obvious internal strife in the Ancient Wild Country, it has always maintained a situation that cannot be broken through fighting.
Regardless of whether it is a player or an aboriginal NPC, in such an environment, they can only roll inward desperately.
The general environment of the ancient wild country is a bit similar to raising Gu, but it is not as tragic as raising Gu. Although it is still not easy to cultivate top talents, it has never lacked the so-called mainstays and has never encountered the dilemma of a lack of talent.
In fact, Rogge Utkin has never understood that the reason why he was able to participate in the opening season of the Wild Ancient Country's hunting season for Neptune-like creatures was not because he built a ship with the style of the Wild Ancient Country, but because he himself had C-level combat power.
Notice! It is a C-level combat power, not a C-level pseudo-combat power.
When the second-level B-level level is not reached, possessing C-level combat power in advance is the most critical element.
Because of the above reasons, after discovering Rogge Utkin's actions, this aboriginal NPC just observed with interest and took no further action.
"Hey! This space fluctuates... Cave Heaven Paradise?"
Just as Rogge Utkin and a group of mercenary group members simultaneously opened the demiplane territories owned by members of the four pavilions (agriculture, forestry, fishery, and animal husbandry) and took out various resources for construction, a mysterious fluctuation also spread, attracting the attention of this aboriginal NPC.
"Hmm... No! This is not the wave emitted by the opening of the complete Cave Heaven Paradise, but the resonance wave caused by the simultaneous opening of a large number of prototypes of the Paradise."
The aboriginal NPC frowned at first, then thought of something and his eyes lit up slightly: "It seems that it should be the Four Pavilions organization that has been rumored recently. Haha, interesting, really interesting."
The aboriginal NPC touched his beard and murmured to himself: "I'm telling you! If these little guys don't hunt Neptune-like creatures properly, what are they doing in this place where dogs don't poop and birds don't lay eggs? It turns out they plan to develop overseas!"
"That's right. With the support of the prototype of the blessed land given by the Four Pavilions organization, the development here is really good. Except for no mines, almost everything you need is available."
"You can build your own ship with wood, there is no shortage of food, and you can hunt sea king creatures as much as you want... Tsk, tsk, tsk! When you think about it, it's really good."
"Although it is said that after the New Year celebrations, Neptune-like creatures will become quiet again and will not be so easy to find, but the difficulty of hunting will also decrease. Over time, more Neptune-like creatures can be hunted."
"It's a pity that this method cannot be promoted and can only be done secretly. If not, those insects overseas may cause trouble again."
